economic_thesis: Funding-crowd unwinds can work outside broad declines, but in market-wide selloffs low funding often marks distress rather than opportunity. A causal router therefore retains confirmed carry unwind in normal conditions and, during broad declines, instead buys relative resilience and shorts downside fragility measured by relative trend, downside capture, and drawdown depth.

expected_regime_roles.bear: The fragility route longs shallow-drawdown, low-downside-capture relative leaders and shorts deep-drawdown, high-downside-capture laggards.
expected_regime_roles.bull: The normal route preserves the confirmed funding-crowding unwind that supported the parent family's bull behavior.
expected_regime_roles.chop: The normal route preserves balanced relative carry/unwind selection rather than imposing directional market exposure.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Normal route: confirmed low-funding relative leaders. Bear route: relative resilience with low downside capture and shallow drawdown.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Normal route: confirmed high-funding relative laggards. Bear route: high downside capture, deep drawdown, and negative relative trend.
expected_regime_roles.stress: The bear route changes security selection without reducing gross or invoking an optional risk policy; all central drawdown and tail gates remain binding.

falsifier: Reject pivot-01 if its no-control core fails any qualification_thresholds.json core_alpha_activation, pivot_01_mechanism_gate, full non-neighborhood development, or team-declared A5 score requirement, including nonpositive bear return or Sharpe, maximum drawdown above 0.30, lost bull/chop behavior, an inactive sleeve, or isolated stability. Controls and neighbors cannot rescue failure.
mechanism: At each 00:00 UTC decision, derive a causal seven-day cross-sectional market return and negative breadth. Outside a broad decline, score the parent confirmed funding-crowd unwind. When median market return is at most -4% and negative breadth is at least 65%, rank each symbol by 45% relative trend, 35% inverse downside beta, and 20% inverse drawdown depth, then rerank the composite. Convert the active route to one signed long-desirability dictionary, cross the A5 boundary once, and use the returned scores for selection and allocation.
risk_policy_plan: Run pivot-01 first with byte-exact root no-control risk_policy.json. Optional controls and neighbors are dormant unless the new core passes qualification_thresholds.json core_alpha_activation, pivot_01_mechanism_gate, every full non-neighborhood development gate, and every team-declared A5 score gate; they cannot repair the terminal parent family or rescue a failed pivot.
selection_metric: All noncompensatory development and A5 gates first. Among passers only, prioritize positive bear Sharpe, maximum drawdown at most 0.30, retained positive bull/chop returns, then the lower of base and doubled-cost Sharpe and worst fold/regime Sharpe.
